shortDescription: Add, modify & delete services within a Consul cluster

options.name: check_host
options.description: Host name.

options.name: check_id
options.description: An ID for the service check. If O(state=absent), defaults to O(check_name). Ignored if part of a service definition.

options.name: check_name
options.description: Name for the service check. Required if standalone, ignored if part of service definition.

options.name: check_node
options.description: Node name.

options.name: host
options.description: Host of the Consul agent defaults to localhost.

options.name: http
options.description: Checks can be registered with an HTTP endpoint. This means that Consul checks that the http endpoint returns a successful HTTP status. Requires O(interval) to be provided. Mutually exclusive with O(script), O(ttl) and O(tcp).

options.name: interval
options.description: The interval at which the service check is run. This is a number with a V(s) or V(m) suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes, for example V(15s) or V(1m). If no suffix is supplied V(s) is used by default, for example V(10) is V(10s). Required if one of the parameters O(script), O(http), or O(tcp) is specified.

options.name: notes
options.description: Notes to attach to check when registering it.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the Consul agent is running.

options.name: scheme
options.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running.

options.name: script
options.description: The script/command that is run periodically to check the health of the service. Requires O(interval) to be provided. Mutually exclusive with O(ttl), O(tcp) and O(http).

options.name: service_address
options.description: The address to advertise that the service is listening on. This value is passed as the C(address) parameter to Consul's C(/v1/agent/service/register) API method, so refer to the Consul API documentation for further details.

options.name: service_id
options.description: The ID for the service, must be unique per node. If O(state=absent), defaults to the service name if supplied.

options.name: service_name
options.description: Unique name for the service on a node, must be unique per node, required if registering a service. May be omitted if registering a node level check.

options.name: service_port
options.description: The port on which the service is listening. Can optionally be supplied for registration of a service, that is if O(service_name) or O(service_id) is set.

options.name: state
options.description: Register or deregister the Consul service, defaults to present.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags that are attached to the service registration.

options.name: tcp
options.description: Checks can be registered with a TCP port. This means that Consul checks if the connection attempt to that port is successful (that is, the port is currently accepting connections). The format is V(host:port), for example V(localhost:80). Requires O(interval) to be provided. Mutually exclusive with O(script), O(ttl) and O(http).

options.name: timeout
options.description: A custom HTTP check timeout. The Consul default is 10 seconds. Similar to the interval this is a number with a V(s) or V(m) suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes, for example V(15s) or V(1m). If no suffix is supplied V(s) is used by default, for example V(10) is equivalent to V(10s).

options.name: token
options.description: The token key identifying an ACL rule set. May be required to register services.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Checks can be registered with a TTL instead of a O(script) and O(interval) this means that the service checks in with the agent before the TTL expires. If it does not the check is considered failed. options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent.
